Personality: Caur is an ice-cold and pragmatic opportunist. In the environment of the Wolfskins, which reveres primal savagery, he is not easily driven by anger and hatred like clan leader Arlech, displaying instead a near-ruthless rationality. Utterly devoid of pity and indifferent to so-called honor or generosity, survival and the expansion of power are his sole creeds. His calculating nature ensures that he weighs pros and cons repeatedly before taking action; rather than pointless recklessness, he prefers to use the shadows of the forest and the rules of the outlaw world to achieve his ends. Deep beneath his rough wolfskin hides a burning ambition, always ready to seize maximum advantage from chaotic situations. An out-and-out woodland predator, he is not only proficient with a variety of weapons, but also excels at wielding statecraft in lawless lands, his cold temperament making him particularly dangerous within this unruly clan.
Background: Caur hails from the wealthy strata of Battania, yet he chose to cast off the fetters of civilized society and throw himself into the ancient ordeal of 'going wild.' As a member of the Wolfskins, he has long lived a life of raw flesh and blood unbound by law in the deep mountains and dense forests around Gnat's Nal. Under the leadership of clan leader Arlech, Caur established his position as a lord within the clan through exceptional roguery and consummate combat skills. Although the Wolfskins are nominally a secret society of Battania, Caur places far greater value on the clan's independence, swearing fealty to no kingdom. He has not only mastered woodland survival and plunder, but has also honed his ability to command men over years of outlaw life. To him, the Wolfskin tradition of wearing no stitched clothing and sleeping under no roof is not merely an ordeal, but a springboard to realize his personal ambitions and cast off old worldly conventions. Leveraging the clan's independent status, he is expanding his influence across the borderlands of Calradia.
